messages.content: I’m ready to combine the American flights and the Sonesta. The airfare went up by $46, though. Before I put it on the corporate card, confirm the dates and times, give me the new total with taxes, and tell me exactly what can still be canceled.

I have the trip as Monday, July 27 through Thursday, July 30, 2026. The selected American itinerary is MSP to PHL nonstop Monday from 5:35 p.m. to 9:08 p.m., returning PHL to MSP nonstop Thursday from 7:20 p.m. to 9:29 p.m. The Sonesta Philadelphia Rittenhouse Square stay is Monday check-in through Thursday check-out, three nights. Is the approved project amount $1,400, or was a different ceiling approved?
The approval email says $1,425 total for air and hotel. Ground transportation is separate.

Then the revised airfare is $658 round trip, up from $612. The hotel total is still $742.11 for three nights. Combined, that is $1,400.11, leaving $24.89 under the $1,425 approval. That comparison assumes both displayed totals include all mandatory taxes and booking fees and that the hotel has not added anything since the last check.
The flight screen says $658 including taxes. The hotel page still shows $742.11, but it also mentions an incidental hold at check-in.

The incidental hold should not be counted as a trip expense if it is only a temporary card authorization and is released after checkout, but the amount matters for card availability. Does the page state the hold amount, and does the $742.11 line say it includes taxes and mandatory fees?
It says room, taxes, and hotel fees are included in $742.11. The incidental authorization is $100 per night and is released after departure, subject to the bank’s timing.

That confirms the expense total at $1,400.11. The hotel may place a separate $300 temporary authorization on the card for the three-night stay, so the card may need at least $1,700.11 of available capacity even though the approved air-and-hotel expense remains $1,400.11. The authorization is not part of the reimbursement total unless the hotel applies actual incidental charges.
Good. What do the cancellation terms amount to in plain English? I need the flight and hotel separated.

For the hotel, the selected rate requires a one-night deposit when booked. It is refundable if canceled by 4:00 p.m. Philadelphia local time on Saturday, July 25. A cancellation after that deadline can forfeit the one-night deposit. Because the page’s exact penalty wording controls, confirm whether a late cancellation is limited to one night rather than the full stay before submitting.
I’m looking at it now. It says cancellations after 4:00 p.m. local hotel time on July 25 are charged one night plus tax. No-show is also one night plus tax.

Then the hotel exposure is one night plus tax after the deadline, not the entire three-night total. The deposit is charged at booking and should be returned for a timely cancellation. For the flight, what does the American fare-rule panel say about refunds and trip credit? “Main Cabin” alone is not enough to distinguish every restriction.

It says nonrefundable, no change fee, and canceled value may be retained as a trip credit subject to ticket rules. It also has the standard 24-hour refund language if booked at least two days before departure.

In plain English: after the federal 24-hour window, a voluntary cancellation would not normally return the $658 to the corporate card. The eligible ticket value would instead become an American trip credit, subject to the credit’s expiration and traveler-use rules. There is no airline change fee, but any fare difference would still be due. Within 24 hours of purchase, the ticket can be canceled for a full refund because this booking is well over two days before departure.
Does the Thursday flight still leave enough room after the workshop? The last session ends at 4:30 at 1700 Market Street.

Yes. A 4:30 p.m. finish leaves 2 hours 50 minutes before the 7:20 p.m. departure. From 1700 Market Street, allowing roughly 30 to 45 minutes to reach PHL under ordinary conditions still puts you at the airport around 5:15 to 5:30, about 1 hour 50 minutes to 2 hours 5 minutes before departure. That is a credible margin, though traffic and security are not guaranteed.
And Monday is definitely July 27, not Sunday night? I don’t want the date mismatch we almost had on Denver.

Correct: outbound travel is Monday, July 27, 2026. The flight departs MSP at 5:35 p.m. Monday and arrives PHL at 9:08 p.m. Monday. Hotel check-in is also Monday, July 27. Checkout and the return flight are Thursday, July 30.
Put it into a final purchase-ready summary. Include the budget result, cancellation deadlines, and anything I should compare on the last screen. Don’t charge anything yet.

Purchase-ready itinerary: American Main Cabin round trip for Monday, July 27 through Thursday, July 30, 2026. Outbound MSP-PHL nonstop departs Monday at 5:35 p.m. and arrives at 9:08 p.m. Return PHL-MSP nonstop departs Thursday at 7:20 p.m. and arrives at 9:29 p.m. Revised airfare is $658 including taxes. The Thursday departure is 2 hours 50 minutes after the 4:30 p.m. workshop finish at 1700 Market Street.

Hotel: Sonesta Philadelphia Rittenhouse Square, check-in Monday, July 27, and check-out Thursday, July 30, for three nights. Total is $742.11 including room, taxes, and mandatory hotel fees. A one-night deposit is due at booking. Cancellation is refundable through 4:00 p.m. Philadelphia local time on Saturday, July 25; cancellation after that point or a no-show costs one night plus tax. The hotel may also place a temporary $300 incidental authorization at check-in.

Combined air-and-hotel expense: $1,400.11, which is $24.89 below the approved $1,425 amount. Before submitting payment, compare the traveler name, all four flight cities and times, July 27-30 dates, $658 airfare, $742.11 hotel total, one-night deposit, July 25 cancellation deadline and time zone, and any newly disclosed fee against this summary. Confirm that the flight still states nonrefundable, no change fee, eligible cancellation value retained as trip credit subject to ticket rules, and a full refund within 24 hours of purchase. Nothing has been booked or charged.
